not_gates.test.yml/record-pass: Uploads the passed tree artifact that lets the dev push skip unit and lint; it grades nothing, and its needs already cover the gates it records.

outside_gate.equivalence.yml/ledger-equivalence: Opt in replay of ledger storage and pages; the equivalence gate task wires it into the gate.
outside_gate.test-leaks.yml/one-process: Hour long single process sweep that runs on a schedule; its pull request run only exercises its own workflow. Retired when the pull request trigger leaves test leaks, which a dispatch run replaces.
outside_gate.test-leaks.yml/followup: Opens follow up issues for the scheduled sweep and skips every pull request run.
